tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Quotes without charging or authorizing payment the live x402 agent rail ($0.05 USDC on Base) and live human Stripe checkouts: $29 Starter Pack (100 generations, paid once) at https://authichain.com/checkout/starter and $299 EU DPP Readiness at https://authichain.com/checkout/dpp_readiness. One

tools.name: verify
tools.description: x402 paid seal-registry verification; use only after separate payment authorization, not for free lookup. Arguments that cannot be a seal UUID are HTTP 400 before payment. Empty arguments are unpaid HTTP 402. Paid calls are answered from the seal registry at $0.05 USDC on Base. For free verification

tools.name: query_provenance
tools.description: Free registry and published-pack lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token; use for discovery, not proof of authenticity. Reads matching rows from the canonical auth_seals registry when public Supabase configuration is available, and also resolves published packs. A registry match means registered onl

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Free. Use when verifying a registry-published attestation, not a supplied offline protocol record. Fetch the exact published AuthiChain v0.1 JWS from the signed-record registry and pass it to the canonical edge-router verifier. Checks signature, issuer trust, durable revocation/status, expiry, and s

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Free. Use for a supplied signed protocol record or demonstration record, not published JWS issuer-status checks. Verify an AuthiChain signed provenance record with the open reference verifier. Pass id "polygon-anchor-1" for the published demonstration record, or pass your own record and anchor JSON.

tools.name: dpp_readiness_check
tools.description: Free informational EU Digital Product Passport readiness questionnaire; this cannot issue a passport or certify compliance. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

tools.name: scan_living_qr
tools.description: Free. Read an existing Living QR presentation, not a QR generator or x402 purchase. Scan a stored Living QR. GET https://authichain.com/qron/r/{object_id} returns AuthiChain Verification Decision v1. This host verifies the signature. A missing id is presentation_not_found. Not an x402 payment endpoi

tools.name: negotiate
tools.description: Free, read-only, non-binding agent-to-agent capability/price-class quote. Returns available service, free vs separately authorized paid rail, and next step; never accepts terms, creates a commitment, transfers money, or calls an external service. This is NOT MCP initialize version negotiation.
